name: Simulated Vegan Shoelace Pasta
description: A whimsical recipe created to test schema validation and error handling. This dish is not intended for human consumption.
instructions: Initiate test sequence by bringing a large pot of water to a rolling boil.
Introduce 'vegan shoelaces' (black bean spaghetti) into the boiling water. Cook for 8-10 minutes or until an assertion failure occurs.
In a separate pan, simulate a sauce by warming the vegetable broth with the Error-Inducing Paprika.
Drain the 'shoelaces' and immediately toss with the simulated sauce.
Garnish with inedible plastic aglets to confirm parser is handling non-food items.
Serve to the void and log the resulting system state.
If no error is thrown, the test has failed. Please re-evaluate your test parameters.
notes: This recipe is a negative test case. Consuming actual shoelaces, vegan or otherwise, is strongly discouraged and may lead to unexpected runtime errors in biological systems.
